title: Prints
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
source: lore/drift_wood/_THE_COMPLETE_RUN.md (1999–2000 · deepening xix · the daily filled)
logline: The dog on the mud. His prints: a line of four-toed marks going out and not coming back the same way. Wood follows them with the pen instead of the leash. The strip is a map before it knows it.

panels.composition: The flats. BARNABY far out on the mud, small. A line of prints from the launch to him.

image.prompt: a small dog far out on a wide mudflat with a single line of paw prints leading to it from a boat launch, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The prints, close: four toes, a pad, the mud lifting at the edges.

image.prompt: close on a dog's paw prints pressed into wet mud with the edges lifting, black and white, no words

panels.composition: WOOD's pen following the line on the pad: a dotted line across bands.

image.prompt: close on a pen drawing a dotted line across horizontal bands on a drawing pad, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The dog coming back a different way. Two lines now. The pad has both. The strip is a map and doesn't know it yet.

image.prompt: a small dog trotting back across a mudflat along a new line of prints beside its first, a young man drawing at the edge, black and white, no words

art.line: brush-pen, committed; black and white; xerox

notes: Two lines of prints. The map, before the map (2007).
